Help with an easy task to further your warrior training; kill a few low level thieves.

==Quest information==
=== Requirements ===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = factions
| profession = Warrior
| primary = y
| secondary = n
}}

===Objectives===
* Prevent the thieves from stealing crops from the field.
* See Weng Gha for your reward.

===Early benefits===
* Weng Gha teaches you the following skills when you accept this quest:
** {{skill icon|Frenzy}}
** {{skill icon|Mighty Blow}}

===Reward===
* 1,500 [[Experience]]
* 100 [[Gold]]
* [[Monastery Credit]]

==Walkthrough==
After you accept this quest, follow the path leading to [[Tsumei Village]]. When you near the marked spot on the mini-map 3 [[Crop Thief|Crop Thieves]] dressed like the [[Crimson Skull]] appear. Kill them and then return to [[Weng Gha]].

==NPCs==
===Foes===
[[Human]]s
*[[Crimson Skull]]
**{{r}} 3 (22) [[Crop Thief]]

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Weng Gha
''Thieves have been stealing long beans from the bean fields nearby. I cannot abide the thievery or those who practice it. There is no honor in that profession, none at all.''

''Go to the '''bean fields''' and see if you can catch those [[Crop Thief|crop thieves]] at their game.''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I'll take care of it.
| decline = Perhaps another time.
| ask = Go to the '''bean fields''' and stop those [[Crop Thief|crop thieves]].
}}

===Intermediate dialogue===
:'''Crop Thief:''' ''"Mercenaries! Run!"''
:'''Crop Thief:''' ''"I tried to tell you we would be caught!"''

===Reward dialogue===
;Weng Gha
''Well done! The crops are safe and you have proven to me that you have what it takes to truly excel as a Warrior.''
